title: Limited: telling a usage limit from a Wake, holding the App, and resuming at the reset
description:
Per the map tickets 'Limited' (harness-0sx.8) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, Limited per App with the rule by Stage); CONTEXT.md (Limited). Research: research/usage-limits (docs/research/usage-limits.md).

Detection: before any Wake (idle with no result, timed out) and any blocked Question, the pane's last ~20 lines (herdr agent read --source recent-unwrapped) are matched against the Stage's App's limit patterns, a new App-table field: claude "You've hit your … limit · resets <t>" and "Usage limit reached · continuing automatically at <t>"; codex "■ You’ve hit your usage limit … try again at <t>" (U+2019). A match whose reset is still ahead is a limit: never a Wake, never a Judgment. Last lines only and a future reset keep an old scrollback line, or an agent quoting the text, from matching. A reset without a date is its next local occurrence; Claude's '(Zone)' is the machine's own; codex's 'Try again later.' has none (now + 1h, then look again). The reset is wall-clock time: give Config a clock the tests can set.

Short limit (reset within 24h), on any Stage but the Review and a Debate side (Ticket 15): the App is Limited. No new Stage starts on it, whichever Ticket it belongs to (a Ticket about to start one holds); its panes are left alone, since a prompt would cancel Claude's own wait; at the reset + 2 minutes a pane still idle with no result gets 'continue'. Stages on other Apps run on. The Stage deadline pauses while Limited and starts fresh at the resume; no nudge, wait or retry is spent. The check before a timeout Wake also catches an App that waits inside its turn while looking working.

Long limit (reset beyond 24h, or Claude's options menu 'What do you want to do?', which reads blocked): every running session's id is saved (Ticket 13), every pane and Ticket tab closes, and the run ends, like /stop-work with nothing left running. /continue after the reset reopens each Ticket's current Stage by its id and sends 'continue'. Nothing reopens by itself.

State: state.json keeps each limit (App, reset), so a /continue after closing the Harness keeps holding until the reset, then resumes.

Screen: an amber box above the input, like Ticket 3's MERGE TO UNBLOCK, one line per Limited App: 'CLAUDE LIMITED until 3:45pm · resumes by itself'. Each held Ticket reads 'limited until 3:45pm' as its stage in TICKETS and counts as working (no status-row count). RECENT: a line on the hit, one on the resume, and on a long limit 'claude weekly limit until Mon 12:00am: sessions saved, panes closed, /continue after the reset'.

Live checks for whoever next hits a limit, not blockers (list them in the result file): herdr's status during Claude's auto-continue wait; the options menu's real footer; Claude's zone read as local time.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world with fake pane tails: claude and codex limit text before a would-be Wake holds the Ticket with no Wake and no Judgment call; another Ticket's next Stage on the same App holds while a Stage on the other App starts; an old limit line above newer output, or a past reset, still Wakes; at the reset + 2 minutes an idle pane without a result gets 'continue'; the deadline does not fire during the hold; a reset beyond 24h saves the ids, closes panes and tabs and ends the run, and /continue resumes by id; state.json round-trips the limits. TestBackend render of the amber box and a held Ticket's row.
